name: UTAC Beta Parameter Estimates - Aggregated Cross-Domain Dataset
source: Aggregated from multiple domain-specific UTAC analyses
license: MIT (aggregated data), see individual sources for original licenses
description: Comprehensive collection of β-parameter estimates from 36 threshold systems across 12 domains. This dataset forms the empirical foundation for UTAC v2.0 Multi-Attractor Framework, demonstrating domain-specific β-clustering (p<10⁻²⁰) and Φ^(n/3) hierarchy validation.
provenance: Compiled from individual UTAC sigmoid fits across domains: AI/LLM (n=9), Climate (n=7), Biology (n=4), Cognition (n=2), Geophysics (n=2), Astrophysics (n=2), Economy (n=1), Socio-ecology (n=3), Neuroscience (n=4), Implosion (n=2). Each entry represents a validated σ(β(R-Θ)) fit with ΔAIC>10 vs null models.

variables.name: domain
variables.description: Domain identifier (e.g., 'llm_emergent', 'climate_amoc', 'honeybee_waggle'). Must match domain_covariates.csv for meta-regression.

variables.name: beta
variables.description: Steepness parameter β from σ(β(R-Θ)) fit. Measures ontological resistance to threshold crossing. Range: 1.22-18.47.

variables.name: beta_ci_lower
variables.description: Lower bound of 95% confidence interval for β

variables.name: beta_ci_upper
variables.description: Upper bound of 95% confidence interval for β

variables.name: beta_ci_width
variables.description: Width of 95% CI (upper - lower). Used for precision weighting in meta-regression.

variables.name: theta
variables.description: Critical threshold Θ in native units (e.g., temperature in K, generations, token count). Varies widely across domains.

variables.name: r_squared
variables.description: Coefficient of determination for σ(β(R-Θ)) fit. Range: 0.895-0.999.

variables.name: delta_aic
variables.description: ΔAIC = AIC_null - AIC_utac. All entries have ΔAIC>10 (strong evidence for UTAC over null). Range: 12.79-148.72.

variables.name: source
variables.description: Primary literature source or data provenance (e.g., 'Wei et al. 2022', 'Blount et al. 2008', 'Synthetic LLM trajectory')

anova.test: One-way ANOVA on β by domain cluster

llm_hypothesis_test.test: Two-sample t-test: Informational vs All Others

usage_notes: Primary dataset for UTAC v2.0 Multi-Attractor Framework validation
Use with domain_covariates.csv for meta-regression analysis
All entries have ΔAIC>10 vs null models (strong UTAC evidence)
Domain identifiers must match exactly between beta_estimates and domain_covariates
For individual dataset details, see domain-specific metadata files (e.g., data/biology/lenski_citplus.metadata.json)

quality_control.outlier_interpretation: Extreme β-values (>14) indicate strong molecular/systemic coupling, not fit failures. See docs/utac_v2_synthesis.md section 'Materie atmet extrem'.
